description: If \([(p,b)]\) occurs in \(\Gamma\), then \(\Gamma\) and \(R_{p,b}(\Gamma)\) are equisatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.unit_equisatisfiable.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {p : α} {b : Bool}
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α} (hunit : [{ atom := p, positive := b }] ∈ Γ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Sat Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Sat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p b Γ)
